note: Config reference only. Nothing here is installed or started by the Red Dragon. Servers marked device_control drive a real phone: never connect or call them without the owner's explicit approval for that exact task.

servers.name: playwright
servers.what: Claude opens a real browser, clicks, fills forms and checks its own page work.

servers.name: figma
servers.install: claude mcp add --transport http figma https://mcp.figma.com/mcp  (or the Figma connector on claude.ai)
servers.cost: any Figma plan; needs Figma sign-in
servers.what: Design context from Figma files to code, and writing native Figma content back to the canvas.

servers.name: hyperframes
servers.install: npx hyperframes skills update  (or npx skills add heygen-com/hyperframes)
servers.what: Write HTML, render video. Skills are already in library/ (hyperframes, hyperframes-cli, media-use, reverse-any-video, style-sampling, slideshow, figma, remotion-to-hyperframes, hyperframes-registry).

servers.name: phone-harness
servers.install: uv tool install --python 3.12 phone-harness  then  phone-harness skill  (hosted MCP: https://mcp.phone-harness.com/mcp)
servers.cost: local: free. Cloud phones: 5 cents per minute, Plus $20/mo, cloud iPhone $80/mo
servers.what: Claude sees the phone screen and taps, types and scrolls (iPhone via Mac iPhone Mirroring, Android via adb, or a rented cloud phone).

servers.name: pinky
servers.install: desktop app from github.com/DIYgod/pinky/releases (brew install --cask diygod/tap/pinky), then Settings > Agents > Connect
servers.what: Same idea with the owner in the loop: every step shown live, risky steps need approval in Pinky's own gateway, owner can take over. Safer choice than phone-harness.

servers.name: ryze-seo
servers.install: claude mcp add ryze --transport http https://connector.get-ryze.ai/mcp
servers.cost: free; reads your Search Console and GA4 after sign-in
servers.what: Keyword research, content briefs, AI-engine visibility, competitor gaps from real data.
